verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is documented as an open-source library and CLI with a Dockerized FastAPI server for self-hosting. That means the developer runs and manages their own infrastructure. The evidence shows no hosted serverless platform where custom scraping scripts can be built and deployed without managing infrastructure, so this applicable axis is unmet.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and deploy custom serverless scraping scripts on the platform without managing my own infrastructure
